title: Connect request
text: Hosted start issues a four-character match code before organization choice. The first signed-in member read or resolve routes that code into the selected organization through machine_authorization.handoff, using its actual engine org_id. Only the active hosted service with an explicit org grant calls handoff. Routing the same request to the same org is idempotent; routing elsewhere refuses with the original org and requires a fresh terminal connection. Consumer source adoption is observed; deployed proof remains pending. The approval card groups machine identity, code, org and local expiry with its zone; the UTC instant stays on the time element.
